description: Flow-sensitive type() dispatch across a 3-variant discriminated union. In each render arm the discriminant cell.kind is flow-narrowed to a single string literal by the compound guard, and type(cell.raw) == cell.kind then narrows the shared raw field to that variant's scalar (number, string, boolean) -- all three arms type-check cleanly. The total loop uses a plain local want flow-narrowed to the literal "number". The only diagnostic is the deliberate misuse: in the number arm cell.raw is narrowed to exactly number, so passing it to a string parameter is rejected with a proven/claimed evidence chain -- proving the narrowing is precise (number, not the declared union).

render_contains: error[type.call.direct.argument_type]: argument 1 (cell.raw) is number, not string
render_ordered_contains: error[type.call.direct.argument_type]: argument 1 (cell.raw) is number, not string
